release_notes: v1.1.6: Adds optional AI transcript polishing through a configurable OpenAI-compatible server. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:11434 and model default; polishing is off until enabled. Sends transcript and vocabulary text only, never audio; HTTP is restricted to loopback and other hosts require HTTPS. Failures preserve the original ASR text for local post-processing. ARM64-only packaging and manual GitHub Releases updates are unchanged.
